name: riptide
description: Riptide: a real-time onchain trading arena on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

scripts.build:program: cargo build-sbf --manifest-path programs/riptide/Cargo.toml && anchor idl build -p riptide -o target/idl/riptide.json -t target/types/riptide.ts && cp target/idl/riptide.json client/idl/riptide.json
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path programs/riptide/Cargo.toml --lib && cargo test --manifest-path tests-magicsvm-rs/Cargo.toml
